comment: No crons here on purpose. Vercel's Hobby plan allows one cron run per day,
and the sync needs to run every ten minutes for 'every dollar, within a few
minutes' to be true. The schedule lives in worker/index.mjs, deployed
The /api/cron/* endpoints are unchanged and still guarded by CRON_SECRET,
so moving back to Vercel Cron on a Pro plan is a matter of restoring the
'crons' array below and stopping the worker.
